name: screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the screen or a window and save to a file.

manual.overview: Use when you need a visual record of the current screen for debugging UI, documenting steps, or sharing what the user sees.

examples.description: Capture a UI bug or layout issue for later analysis
Save screenshot to a specific user-visible location
Use default path (screenshot.png) in current working directory

tips: Specify output_path with full path if the user needs to find the file easily
Avoid capturing sensitive content; warn user before screenshots
Works best when display is active; headless setups may need virtual display
edge_cases: Multi-monitor setups may capture primary display only
Output directory must exist and be writable
